name: Upper Valley Music Center Summer Camps and Programs
description_short: Upper Valley Music Center, a community music school in Lebanon, NH, runs short half-day summer camps for children and teens: Singing for the Stage (ages 10 to 13), Rhythm Kids music and movement (ages 5 to 10), Painting to the Music with AVA Gallery (ages 6 to 12) and an All-State audition week for high school string players.

sessions.name: Singing for the Stage Summer Camp, ages 10-13 (Mon-Fri 9am-12pm)
Painting to the Music, ages 6-8 (mornings 9am-12pm, AVA Gallery & Art Center)
Painting to the Music, ages 9-12 (afternoons 1:30-4:30pm, AVA Gallery & Art Center)

sources.note: Rhythm Kids Session 2 takes ages 5-8; cost $208-$260 for 4 or 5 days
Singing for the Stage: $325 for the one-week camp; page links Tuition Assistance

warnings: The page shows only the Summer 2026 season, which has already ended (today is 2026-10-13). Summer 2027 dates are not posted yet.

This is an overview page for a music school's whole summer offering, not a single camp. Ages range from birth (Music Together) to adults and seniors, so no overall age range was recorded. Ages are given per session where the page states them.
Piano Practice Camp and Diving into Classical Composers were cancelled for Summer 2026 and are left out.
The Colburn Park Trad Music Festival dates don't state a year. 2026 was assumed from the context and the weekday match.

Ongoing summer classes and ensembles (Summer Band, SingAble, Summer Music Together, Slow Jam workshops) and the adult Hanover Street Chamber Music Festival, which has no fixed dates, are not listed as camp sessions.
Painting to the Music takes place at the AVA Gallery & Art Center, not at the main UVMC address.
